proposed_widenings.name: familiarity_table_resolution
proposed_widenings.justification: Teleport's resolution is a DM-rolled 1d100 against a familiarity-indexed probability table with four outcome branches (On Target, Off Target, Similar Area, Mishap). This is neither an attack_roll nor a save_gate — there is no flat-percentage table phase in the current ActivationPhase union. The familiarity input itself is DM-assessed at cast time (6 tiers: permanent circle, linked object, very familiar, seen casually, viewed once or described, false destination), making the effective probability range dynamic. A new phase kind — something like probability_table — would be needed to encode this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The DM rolls 1d100 and consults the Teleportation Outcome table... [rows: Permanent circle 01-00 On Target; Very familiar 01-05 Mishap / 06-13 Similar Area / 14-24 Off Target / 25-00 On Target; ...]

proposed_widenings.name: transport Effect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The primary effect of Teleport is moving the caster plus up to eight willing creatures (or a Large-or-smaller object) to a chosen destination. The v4 atom inventory includes transport_exile but it does not appear in the surface Effect union type (DamageEffect | NoneEffect). A transport variant is required for the On Target branch, and a misplaced-transport variant for Off Target / Similar Area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

proposed_widenings.name: imprecise_transport (Off Target / Similar Area outcome branches)
proposed_widenings.justification: Two of the four outcome branches describe transport that lands in the wrong place: Off Target places the party 2d12 miles away in a random direction; Similar Area places them in the nearest thematically similar location. Neither is expressible as a DamageEffect, a condition, or any existing Effect variant. These would require either new Effect variants or a richer transport atom with an accuracy parameter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Off Target: You and your group appear 2d12 miles away from the destination in a random direction. Roll 1d8 for the direction. / Similar Area: You and your group appear in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area.

notes: Teleport is instantaneous (not ongoing_effect). Its resolution is a 1d100 DM table keyed on familiarity — wholly outside attack_roll and save_gate. The Mishap path (3d10 Force damage per teleporting creature) is in principle encodable as a DamageEffect but is only reachable through the missing probability_table phase. The transport effect needed for On Target / Off Target / Similar Area has no surface representation despite existing in the v4 atom inventory. There is no honest family mapping; the unit requires structural widening before encoding is possible.
